summary: Iteration 8: verified this session's 5 items — (1) Google login endpoint guards (400 without X-Session-ID, 401 with bogus id, no live OAuth attempted; 'Continue with Google' button rendered on /auth), (2) ABAC enforcement (rule CRUD, evaluate/decision matched, deny precedence over allow, protected-demo -> 200 when off, 403 when enforce ON and matching deny rule exists, non-admin gets 403 on admin routes), (3) Third-Party/Vendor Risk (composition ribbon has 7 items, VND-001..004 seeded, VND-002 & VND-004 = Critical tier, assess recomputes and creates remediation workflow + vendor_risk notification, POST /api/vendors monotonically increments, non-admin gets 403), (4) Branding GET/PUT persists (admin-only), (5) Benchmarking returns 3 metrics with you/peer_median/top_quartile/percentile. Backend pytest: 20/20 passed. Frontend UI selectors all present under admin persona; operational persona correctly hides nav-enterprise and per-row assess buttons; login/logout works normally alongside Google button. Regression sanity: manifest(15) + policies OK. Cleanup executed (ABAC enforce OFF, all abac_rules deleted, extra vendors purged, vendors.last_assessed reset, vendor_risk notifications + remediation workflows for VND-* removed, org.branding unset, enterprise_config removed).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py /auth/google/session catches all httpx exceptions -> 502 'Auth provider unreachable'; a transient upstream 5xx now returns 502 while our tests + spec expected 401 for bogus sessions. Tests already accept either, but consider surfacing 401 for non-200 upstream and 502 only for network errors to keep the guard semantics tight.

enterprise.py abac_decision uses str(attrs.get(...)) so numeric attributes get stringified — 'in' operator also splits comma; documented behavior but easy to misuse (e.g. list attribute values are not iterated).

insights.py /branding returns full dict on PUT (body.model_dump()) but GET merges DEFAULT_BRANDING with org.branding — asymmetric responses could mask missing fields after PUT. Consider returning the merged shape.

tpr.py assess uses vendor's stored raw fields to recompute but never updates them via /api/vendors/{ref} PATCH — no way for admin to edit attestation/incidents (only re-score current state). Add PATCH if editing is intended.
tpr.py notifications dedupe_key='vendor:{ref}:{sc}' means repeated same-score assessments won't create a new notification; documented via kernel notifications.create dedupe, acceptable.
